comparison.objective: Push a packet completely through a spring flap into a drop box.
comparison.physical_skill: Choose a grasp and insertion strategy that advances the packet beyond a hand-blocking panel and lets the flap close.
comparison.success_condition: Packet entirely inside and at rest with the flap shut.
comparison.reason: This is constrained insertion through a compliant flap. It has no impact-induced fracture, bimanual tool interaction, retained-component damage constraint, or small-fragment recovery.
